summary.title: Bookstore checkout
summary.description: Threat model of the Bookstore checkout, Payments and Shipping integrations and the institutional purchase approval.

diagrams.title: Checkout, Payments and Shipping
diagrams.description: Customer checkout: order placement, hosted payment page, provider webhook, shipment.

data.name:
Customer
(bookstore-web)
data.description: Angular SPA in the customer's browser; anonymous or signed-in customer.

data.name: Ordering
data.description: POST /api/carts, POST /api/orders: cart, price, stock reservation.

threats.title: Parallel orders oversell stock
threats.description: Two checkouts reserve the last copies at the same time.
threats.mitigation: Conditional UPDATE inside one transaction. Test: Two_parallel_orders_cannot_reserve_more_than_the_stock.

threats.title: Order placement flood
threats.description: Scripts create carts and orders to exhaust stock reservations.
threats.mitigation: Rate limit POST /api/orders per client (ASVS v5.0.0-2.4.1); backlog item SEC-14.

data.name: Payments
data.description: Starts a payment session and handles the provider webhook.

threats.title: Webhook replay
threats.description: A valid, captured webhook is sent again.
threats.mitigation: Store processed event ids (unique index); reject old timestamps. Backlog item SEC-12.

threats.title: No trace of who changed the payment state
threats.description: Support cannot prove whether a status change came from the provider or from back office.
threats.mitigation: Write a security event with event id and source for every status change.

data.name: Shipping
data.description: Creates the shipment for a paid order; receives tracking events.

threats.title: Customer data readable from backups
threats.description: Database backups copied outside the database boundary.
threats.mitigation: Encrypted backups and a restricted storage account; the residual risk is accepted (risk-register.md R-01).

data.name: Payment provider
data.description: Hosted payment page and 3-D Secure; card data stays here.

threats.title: Client-supplied price or total
threats.description: The SPA could send a unit price or total and the API could trust it.
threats.mitigation: Prices and totals are read from Catalog on the server; the request carries only cart id and customer data. Test: OrderingTests.

threats.title: Forged payment webhook
threats.description: Anyone on the internet can POST a payment.succeeded event and mark an unpaid order as Paid.
threats.mitigation: Verify the provider's HMAC signature and timestamp; then re-read the payment status from the provider API. Backlog item SEC-11 + test.

threats.title: Carrier receives more data than needed
threats.description: The full order (items, prices, e-mail) is sent to the carrier.
threats.mitigation: Send only name, address and parcel data (data minimisation; see the KVKK series).

diagrams.title: Institutional purchase approval
diagrams.description: Kurumsal Sipariş: purchase request, approval above the unit limit, institutional order.

data.name: InstitutionBuyer
data.description: Creates purchase requests for a unit (min. 20 copies).

data.name: InstitutionApprover
data.description: Approves requests above the unit's approval limit.

threats.title: Buyer approves own purchase request
threats.description: A user with both roles, or a forged approve call, approves a request they created.
threats.mitigation: Approver must be an InstitutionApprover of the same institution and not the requester. Test: PurchaseApprovalTests.

threats.title: Request changed after approval
threats.description: Lines are changed after approval and the approved request is ordered with the new lines.
threats.mitigation: Approval stores a hash of the approved lines; ordering fails if it no longer matches. Test: PurchaseApprovalTests.

threats.title: Ordering without approval
threats.description: The order step is called directly for a request that needs approval.
threats.mitigation: The order step checks the state server side (ASVS v5.0.0-2.3.1). Test: PurchaseApprovalTests.

threats.title: Splitting a request to stay under the approval limit
threats.description: Several small requests, each under the limit, add up to a large order.
threats.mitigation: Accepted for release 1 (risk-register.md R-02, owner Selin, review 2027-03-01); monitor daily totals per unit.
